doubts.topic: Quadratic Equations - Nature of Roots & Word Problems
doubts.question: In exercise 4.4 word problem 3, how to correctly frame the speed equation for the express train vs passenger train?
doubts.reply: Assume speed of passenger train = x km/h. Speed of express train = (x + 11) km/h. Distance = 132 km. Equation: 132/x - 132/(x+11) = 1. Fully solved on doubt board.

onlineTests.title: Class 10 Science Olympiad (NSO Level 1) Full Mock Test
onlineTests.subject: Science
onlineTests.instructions: Each correct answer carries +4 marks. Incorrect answers carry -1 mark deduction. Live countdown timer will auto-submit answers upon expiration.

questions.text: An object is placed 12 cm in front of a concave mirror of focal length 8 cm. What is the position and magnification of the image formed?
questions.explanation: Using mirror formula 1/f = 1/v + 1/u: 1/(-8) = 1/v + 1/(-12) => 1/v = -1/8 + 1/12 = -1/24. Thus v = -24 cm. Magnification m = -v/u = -(-24)/(-12) = -2 (Real and inverted).

questions.text: Which of the following processes represents an exothermic displacement reaction?

options.text: Reaction of quicklime with water: CaO + H2O → Ca(OH)2

questions.explanation: In the Thermite reaction, Aluminium displaces Iron from Fe2O3. It is both a displacement reaction and highly exothermic (molten iron is formed).

questions.text: Three resistors of 2 Ω, 3 Ω, and 6 Ω are connected in parallel across a 12V battery. What is the total current drawn from the battery?
questions.explanation: Equivalent resistance 1/Rp = 1/2 + 1/3 + 1/6 = 6/6 = 1 Ω. Total current I = V / Rp = 12V / 1Ω = 12 A.

questions.text: In human males, the testes lie outside the abdominal cavity in scrotum because it helps in:

options.text: Maintaining temperature 2 to 2.5°C lower than normal body temperature

questions.explanation: Spermatogenesis requires a temperature of 2-2.5°C lower than the core body temperature of 37°C, which is provided by the scrotum outside the abdominal cavity.

questions.text: If the roots of the quadratic equation px^2 + qx + r = 0 are in the ratio 2:3, then which of the following relations holds true?
questions.explanation: Let roots be 2k and 3k. Sum = 5k = -q/p => k = -q/(5p). Product = 6k^2 = r/p => 6(-q/(5p))^2 = r/p => 6q^2 / (25p^2) = r/p => 6q^2 = 25pr.
